title: 第855章 渡劫人在他们当中第854章 是天劫
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 祖临戈发现一个漏洞，“不是说栖灵宝境是天地孕育的独立秘境，拥有自己的法则能量吗，怎么外界的天劫还会影响栖灵宝境内的法则？”
像栖灵宝境这样的天地秘境，相当于一片小型天地，和外界是不连通的，天劫从妖界来，理应不该波及到栖灵宝境。
元逍抬起眼皮，透过魔气朝高处的眼睛看去，那双巨眸镶嵌在顶壁上，还是那般强大有压迫感，可他却从其中捕捉到了一丝惊愕与隐藏的极深的慌乱。
他开口，带着戳破那丝慌乱的力道，一字一字道，“栖灵宝境先前是独立秘境，现在不是了，它被炼化了。”
被炼化了，可是……祖临戈还想问什么，问题没出口，他自己仿若明白了什么，眼眸微微瞪大，神情难掩的惊异。
转头，他的眼神从在场所有妖身上一一扫过，像是在寻找目标。
最后，停在林筱身上。
祖临戈张张嘴，却说不出一个字，他不知该如何形容他此刻的内心想法，各种情绪翻滚着，最后化为了一个念头。
或许，这一轮并不完全是死局。
元逍还在继续说，“秘境内的法则逐渐和外界同源，这也是我们进来栖灵宝境还能感受到外界情况的原因。”
“现在的栖灵宝境不再是秘境，而是那魔族老祖的身躯，一个人的肉身自然无法阻止天劫降临。”
“至于我们为什么会感觉有危机感……”
“因为天劫就在我们上方。”
元逍说完，还是有妖云里雾里，不明所以，反应过来的妖和祖临戈一样止不住的震惊。
天劫在他们上方，他们有被锁定的感觉，栖灵宝境法则灵力暴动。
这些所有都指向一个可能。
渡劫人，就在他们当中！
是谁？
魔气几乎要贴在蓝精灵身上，可那连肉眼都分辨不出的微小距离却好似比天涯海角还要遥远，永远无法触及跨越。
在烛冥昪玦眼中，林筱等人已经是死人了，他看都没往下看，注意全在他刚刚搜魔族族人搜来的记忆上。
那魔族族人本体修为还不低，突破到了合体高阶。
可真正令他意外的，是这族人灵魂中竟有好几部分记忆他无法查探。
就宛若被人强行抹去，只留一片空白。
这是一件相当匪夷所思的事，要不就可以查探，要不就全无法查探，怎么能有的记忆可以看，有的记忆看不了？
他不信邪，动用力量想强行恢复那几段空白记忆，可不等他将能量触碰到那记忆片段，一股深深的危机感袭上心头，就仿佛本能告诉他，如果他这么做了，会有致命威胁。
和妖界修真界六个圆满大乘打，他都没这么毛骨悚然过。
能量悬停在记忆片段上方，犹豫要不要继续落下。
相对于知道这魔族族人被抹去的记忆是什么，他更不满这种威胁感。
他活了这么久，什么没经历过，他最讨厌有人压在他头上威胁他，比死亡更讨厌。
纠结间，一道雷声响起，恍惚间，他好似回到了几年前，他还在计算需要吞食多少妖的血肉才可复活，也是这样一道雷声将他思绪打断。
又是哪个妖界大能渡劫？
这是他第一想法，随后，他惊觉不对。
content_en:
Zu Linge discovered a loophole, "Didn't it mean that the Qiling Treasure Realm is an independent secret realm bred by heaven and earth, and has its own law energy? How come the external calamity still affects the laws within the Qiling Treasure Realm?"
A secret realm of heaven and earth like the Qiling Treasure Realm is equivalent to a small world and is not connected to the outside world. The calamity comes from the demon world, so it should not affect the Qiling Treasure Realm.
Yuan Xiao raised his eyelids and looked at the eyes high up through the demonic aura. Those giant eyes were embedded in the ceiling wall. They were still so powerful and oppressive, but he caught a hint of shock and deep panic hidden in them.
He opened his mouth, with the strength to break through the panic, and said word by word, "The Living Treasure Realm used to be an independent secret realm, but it is no longer, it has been refined."
It was refined, but... what else did Zu Linge want to ask, but the question remained unspoken. He seemed to understand something, his eyes widened slightly, and he could not hide his surprise.
Turning his head, his eyes swept over all the monsters present, as if looking for a target.
Finally, it stopped on Lin Xiao.
Zu Linge opened his mouth, but couldn't utter a word. He didn't know how to describe his inner thoughts at the moment. Various emotions rolled around and finally turned into a thought.
Perhaps, this round is not entirely a dead end.
Yuan Xiao continued to say, "The laws in the secret realm gradually have the same origin as those in the outside world. This is why we can still feel the outside world when we enter the Soul Residence Treasure Realm."
"The current Soul-Living Treasure Realm is no longer a secret realm, but the body of the demon ancestor. Naturally, a human body cannot prevent the calamity from coming."
"As for why we feel a sense of crisis..."
"Because the catastrophe is right above us."
After Yuan Xiao finished speaking, there was still a demon in the clouds. He didn't know why, and the demon who reacted was as shocked as Zu Linge.
The Heavenly Tribulation was above them, and they felt like they were being locked in. The spiritual power of the Spiritual Treasure Realm laws was rioting.
All of these point to a possibility.
The people who overcome the tribulation are among them!
Who is it?
…
The demonic energy almost clung to Smurf's body, but the tiny distance that even the naked eye couldn't distinguish seemed to be further away than the ends of the world, and could never be touched or crossed.
In Zhu Ming Mingjue's eyes, Lin Xiao and others were already dead. He didn't even look down. His attention was focused on the memories he had just collected from the demon clan members.
The demon clan member's body cultivation level is not low, and he has broken through to the high level of integration.
But what really surprised him was that there were several parts of memories in the souls of this people that he couldn't detect.
It was as if someone had forcibly erased it, leaving only a blank space.
This is a rather unbelievable thing. Either it can be investigated, or it cannot be investigated at all. How can some memories be seen and others not?
He did not believe in evil, and used his strength to forcibly restore those blank memories, but before he could touch the energy to those memory fragments, a deep sense of crisis hit his heart, as if his instinct told him that if he did this, there would be a fatal threat.
He has never been so frightened by the six perfect Mahayana fights in the demon world and cultivation world.
The energy hovers above the memory fragment, hesitating whether to continue falling.
He was more dissatisfied with this sense of threat than knowing what the demon clan member's erased memory was.
He has lived for so long and has never experienced anything. What he hates the most is someone standing on his head and threatening him. He hates it more than death.
While he was struggling, a thunder sounded. In a daze, he seemed to have gone back to a few years ago, when he was still calculating how much demon flesh and blood he would need to swallow before he could be resurrected. Such a thunder interrupted his thoughts.
Which demon world is capable of overcoming the tribulation?
This was his first thought, and then he realized something was wrong.
title_en: Chapter 855: The people who have overcome the tribulation are among them. Chapter 854: It’s a natural tribulation.
